description: The average trading volume for the security, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'VolAvg' column in the PulsePick files.
The backtested hit ratio for the corresponding trading signal, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'Ratio' column in the PulsePick files.
Number of employees in the entity (e.g., company, index, person)
Description of the company from snapshot data
Business sector or industry classification for the entity
The daily close price of the stock, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'close' column in the PulsePickPerformance files.
The mean of the anticipated stock price change based on the trading signal, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'Mean' column in the PulsePick files.
The daily high price of the stock, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'high' column in the PulsePickPerformance files.
The percentage stock price change from the daily open to the high (for a buy signal) or low (for a sell signal). This is a double calculated as 'value * 100'.
The daily low price of the stock, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'low' column in the PulsePickPerformance files.
The daily open price of the stock, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'open' column in the PulsePickPerformance files.
The percentage stock price change from the daily open to the close price. This is a double calculated as 'value * 100' and sourced from the 'dayclose' field.
The aggregate sentiment score derived from social media and news. A value of 0 is neutral, positive values indicate positive opinion, and negative values indicate negative opinion.
The statistical significance of the backtesting hit ratio, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'Significance' column in the PulsePick files.
The standard deviation of the anticipated stock price change based on the trading signal, provided as a double. This field is sourced from the 'StdDev' column in the PulsePick files.
